claims: Artemis I was an uncrewed test flight of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft.
Artemis II was the first crewed flight.
Artemis II's crew was Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II flew around the Moon.
Artemis II traveled over 250,000 miles from Earth.
Artemis III is planned to land astronauts on the lunar South Pole.
Artemis III is planned to use commercial landers.
Artemis III is planned to mark the first crewed landing since 1972.
Artemis IV is a mission to put boots on the Moon.
Artemis IV involves the delivery of a new lunar space station module (Gateway).
Artemis III/IV are targeted for 2027-2028 to land the first woman/person of color.
The Artemis program relies on the Canadian Space Agency for Canadarm3.
The Artemis program relies on private companies like SpaceX and Blue Origin for landing systems.
